baseline.method: Independently executed original PCP ADMM, full real film, 1657iterations, no actual component truth

metric_definition: Each full component Euclidean error divided by its reference norm; additive error norm(D-L-S)/norm(D), D=stored grayscale/255; no alignment/intensity fitting/crop
provenance: Nonzero numerical budgets fixed in success_criteria before local extraction; original1000iteration budget was insufficient, increasedto3000 without relaxing convergence threshold. Canonical original1657stoppedat1e-7.
